请在目标 Mac 允许 TaroBird 使用辅助功能，再点击开始控制。: Allow TaroBird in Accessibility on the target Mac, then start control again.
控制授权已过期，请重新点击开始控制。: Control permission expired. Click Start control again.
目标 Mac 未确认控制，请检查权限后重试。: The target Mac did not confirm control. Check its permissions and try again.
控制已暂停，请等待新画面后重新开始控制。: Control is paused. Wait for a fresh frame, then start control again.
目标 Mac 的本机接管检测未就绪。请在目标 Mac 检查辅助功能和输入监控权限: Local takeover detection is not ready on the target Mac. Check Accessibility and Input Monitoring permissions there, then reconnect.
请在目标 Mac 的远程屏幕设置中允许此设备查看并控制。: Allow this device to view and control in Remote screen settings on the target Mac.
找不到本机主机服务，请检查主机状态后重试屏幕服务。: Cannot reach the local host service. Check host status, then retry the screen service.
连接本机主机服务超时，请重试屏幕服务。: The local host service timed out. Retry the screen service.
此主机需要更新后才能使用远程屏幕。: Update this host to use Remote screen.
主机未确认屏幕服务注册，请重试屏幕服务。: The host did not confirm screen service registration. Retry the screen service.
屏幕服务注册失败，请重试并检查目标主机。: Screen service registration failed. Retry and check the target host.
屏幕服务启动失败，请重试；若仍失败，请保存工作后重新打开 TaroBird。: The screen service could not start. Retry; if it still fails, save your work and reopen TaroBird.
屏幕原生模块不可用，请重新安装完整的 TaroBird 桌面版。: The native screen module is unavailable. Reinstall the complete TaroBird desktop app.
系统设置未能打开，请在系统设置 → 隐私与安全性中打开对应权限页面后重试。: System Settings could not open. Open the relevant page under System Settings → Privacy & Security, then retry.
系统权限请求未完成，请重试或在系统设置 → 隐私与安全性中添加 TaroBird: The permission request did not complete. Retry or add TaroBird under System Settings → Privacy & Security.
检测到多份主机数据，请先解决主机目录冲突，再重试屏幕服务。: Multiple host data directories were found. Resolve the conflict before retrying the screen service.
主机目录被重定向，请检查主机数据目录。: The host directory is redirected. Check the host data directory.
无法读取主机目录，请检查文件访问权限后重试屏幕服务。: Cannot read the host directory. Check file access permissions, then retry the screen service.
屏幕服务不可用，请检查本机桌面版是否完整安装。: The screen service is unavailable. Check that the desktop app is fully installed.
正在读取屏幕状态，请稍候或刷新。: Reading screen status. Please wait or refresh.
请先在目标 Mac 开启允许远程屏幕。: Turn on Allow remote screen on the target Mac first.
此设备尚未获得查看授权。: This device has not been granted viewing access.
屏幕服务尚未注册，请在目标 Mac 检查或重试屏幕服务。: The screen service is not registered. Check or retry it on the target Mac.
目标 Mac 没有可用显示器。: No display is available on the target Mac.
此入口暂时无法打开屏幕，请重新打开连接设置。: This entry cannot open the screen right now. Reopen connection settings.
查看只需屏幕录制权限；远程控制还需辅助功能与输入监控。配对和总开关不会自动授权设: Viewing requires Screen Recording. Control also requires Accessibility and Input Monitoring. Pairing and the main switch do not grant device access.
当前 App 已打开；屏幕服务注册状态与系统权限分别检查。: This app is open. Screen service registration and system permissions are checked separately.
已打开系统设置，是否授权以返回后的检测结果为准。: System Settings opened. Permission will be checked again when you return.
权限请求已发起，请完成系统提示后返回此处。: Permission was requested. Complete the system prompt, then return here.
列表中没有 TaroBird 时，点击“+”，选择“应用程序”中当前安装的 Ta: If TaroBird is missing, click “+” and choose the installed TaroBird application. Do not select an old backup, Node, or another app.
若 macOS 要求重新打开应用，请先保存当前工作，再退出并重新打开 TaroB: If macOS asks you to reopen the app, save your work before quitting and reopening TaroBird. Opening Settings does not grant permission.
请在目标 Mac 的已配对设备列表中，明确允许此设备“仅查看”或“查看并控制”。: On the target Mac, explicitly allow View only or View and control for this device in the paired device list.
请先保存或取消连接修改。: Save or cancel connection changes first.
请等待当前操作完成。: Wait for the current operation to finish.
主机回复格式无效，请检查 App 与主机版本后重试。: The host returned an invalid response. Check the app and host versions, then retry.
无法连接主机的屏幕服务，请检查主机状态后重试。: Cannot connect to the host screen service. Check host status, then retry.
屏幕服务与主机的连接已断开，正在自动重连。: The screen service disconnected from the host and is reconnecting automatically.
主机控制文件权限不安全，请修复主机文件权限后重试。: The host control file permissions are unsafe. Fix them before retrying.
主机拒绝屏幕服务注册，请检查主机状态后重试。: The host rejected screen service registration. Check host status, then retry.
另一个桌面服务已连接此主机，请检查是否打开了多份 TaroBird。: Another desktop service is connected to this host. Check whether multiple copies of TaroBird are open.
屏幕服务协议不兼容，请检查 App 与主机版本后重试。: The screen service protocol is incompatible. Check the app and host versions, then retry.
屏幕服务注册凭据已失效，请重试屏幕服务。: The screen service registration ticket is no longer valid. Retry the screen service.
屏幕服务请求过于频繁，请稍候重试。: Screen service requests are too frequent. Wait a moment and retry.
此权限已授权，无需再次请求。: This permission is already allowed; no new request is needed.
已检查权限，请以当前检测结果为准。: Permission was checked. Refer to the current status.
无法读取本机显示器信息，请确认当前用户已登录桌面后重试。: Unable to read the local displays. Sign in to the Mac desktop and retry.
App 正在安装更新，完成后将重试屏幕服务。: An App update is installing. The screen service will retry when it finishes.
设计尚未保存，更新尚未开始。请保留设计页面并重试保存。: The design is not saved, so the update has not started. Keep Design open and retry saving.
配对和总开关不会自动授权设备。: Pairing and the main switch do not grant device access.
开启后，仍需单独授权设备。: Turning this on still requires separate device access grants.
无法读取屏幕状态，请刷新重试。: Screen status could not be read. Refresh to try again.

若尚未开始回复，只取消等待；若已开始回复，可能也会中断该 Bot 在此对话中正在: If the reply has not started, this only cancels the wait. If it has started, stopping may also interrupt this Bot’s active background work in this conversation.
后台任务列表暂时无法核对；停止仍可能影响此对话中的后台任务。: The background task list could not be checked. Stopping may still affect background work in this conversation.
如果只想停止某一项，可在任务列表中单独停止。: To stop just one task, stop it separately in the task list.
这张工单现在不需要验收。: This ticket does not need review now.
操作结果未确认，请稍后重试。: The result was not confirmed. Try again shortly.
此主机尚不支持移除工单，请更新主机后重试。: This host does not support removing tickets yet. Update the host and try again.
正在进行的工作会停止，对话记录保留。: Work in progress stops; the conversation history is kept.
进行中的工单不受影响；之后派出的工单使用新设置。: Tickets in progress are unaffected; tickets assigned later use the new settings.
上面的引擎、模型和推理强度是它自己思考用的；派出去的每张工单可以各自选择。: The engine, model and effort above are for its own thinking; each ticket it assigns can use its own.
你只说目标，它会拆分任务，并调用这台主机上已安装的 CLI 去做。只能在创建时选: Tell it the goal; it splits the work and runs it with the CLIs installed on this host. Can only be chosen at creation.
不需要另外建 Bot；过程不占对话列表，只在需要你决定或验收时提醒你。: No other Bots needed; the work stays out of your conversation list, and it only reaches out when you need to decide or review.
跟它说要做什么，它会拆成工单交给本机的 CLI 去做，并在这里汇报结果。: Tell it what you need. It splits the work into tickets for the CLIs on this host and reports back here.
这台主机还没有检测到可用的 CLI；安装并登录后即可使用。: No CLI was found on this host yet. Install and sign in to one to use it.
决定它可以用哪些 CLI、派活前是否先问你，以及同时进行几张。: Choose which CLIs it may use, whether it asks you before dispatching, and how many tickets run at once.
幕僚长只有一个对话，请回到它现有的对话。: A Chancellor has only one conversation. Go back to its existing conversation.
调试用：显示幕僚长派活时开的内部对话。: For debugging: show the internal conversations a Chancellor opens for assigned work.
其他设备已修改幕僚长设置。请重新读取后再保存。: Another device changed the Chancellor settings. Reload them before saving.
此主机尚不支持幕僚长，请更新主机版本。: This host does not support Chancellors yet. Update the host.
正在等待执行停止，确认结束后才能继续。: Waiting for execution to stop. You can resume after it has ended.
打开执行会话，处理问题或权限审批。: Open the worker conversation to answer or review permissions.
自动选型会受幕僚长自身模型影响，可能偏向同系列，也可能选择其他系列。若需要特定系: Automatic selection is influenced by the Chancellor’s model. It may favor its own family or choose another. If you need a specific family, specify it in your task, for example, “Use Claude for this.” Its engine must be installed and allowed in Chancellor settings.
不同模型和任务的选择可能不同；自动选型不保证选到最合适的模型，仍需核对任务结果。: Choices can differ by model and task. Automatic selection does not guarantee the best model; task results still need review.
幕僚长会先说明分工，征得你同意后再派出工单。: The Chancellor will explain the plan and ask for your approval before dispatching tickets.
幕僚长可自行派出工单，完成后向你汇报。: The Chancellor can dispatch tickets on its own and report back when finished.
修改尚未保存，点击「保存到此 Bot」后生效。: Changes are not saved. Click “Save for this Bot” to apply them.
当前显示的是主机已保存的设置。: These are the settings saved on the host.
保存结果尚未确认，请核对下方提示。: The save result is unconfirmed. Check the message below.
这些修改尚未保存。请返回编辑页保存，或放弃修改后退出。: These changes are not saved. Return to the editor to save, or discard them to leave.
重新读取会丢弃本页未保存的修改，恢复主机已保存的设置。: Reloading discards unsaved changes on this page and restores the settings saved on the host.
上次保存结果尚未确认。放弃本页修改不会撤销主机可能已保存的设置，请重新读取核对。: The last save is unconfirmed. Discarding local edits will not undo settings that may already be saved on the host. Reload to verify them.
只能移除已完成或已取消的工单。: Only completed or cancelled tickets can be removed.
从此幕僚长的工单列表移除，保留执行对话和生成文件。: Remove it from this Chancellor’s ticket list. Execution chats and generated files will be kept.

目标 Mac 的 App 暂不支持画质选择，请更新后重试，或以默认画质连接。: The target Mac app does not support quality selection yet. Update it or connect with default quality.
主机未确认所选画质，请检查两端版本后重试。: The Host did not confirm the selected quality. Check both app versions and retry.
屏幕连接请求超时，请检查线路后重试。: The screen connection request timed out. Check the connection and retry.
此设备不支持清晰画质解码，请改用均衡或流畅。: This device cannot decode Sharp quality. Choose Balanced or Smooth.
这条消息已交给 Bot，不能再调整这条消息。: This message has been handed to the Bot and can no longer be changed.
已暂停这条消息，后面的消息会继续执行。: This message is paused. Later messages will continue.
已恢复排队，将按顺序执行。: Back in the queue. It will run in order.
请先在工作台打开原设计，再发送评论。草稿已保留。: Open the original design in the workbench before sending its comments. Your draft is kept.
设计评论已加入草稿；修改回到原设计项目。: Design comments are in the draft; changes target the original project.
设计评论暂不支持自动群讨论，请改用普通聊天或点名单个 Bot。草稿已保留。: Design comments are not supported in automatic group discussions yet. Use a regular chat or mention one Bot. Your draft is preserved.
设置角色、语气与偏好；留空则移除文件中的人设要求。: Set a role, tone and preferences. Leave blank to remove persona instructions from the file.
保存只更新文件。需要在当前对话使用新版时，请让 Bot 重新读取人设文件。: Saving updates the file. To use the latest version in this conversation, ask the Bot to reread its persona instructions.
请更新接收主机后使用跨主机消息授权。: Update the receiving host to manage cross-host message permissions.
只有已认证的接收主机所有者可以管理跨主机授权。: Only an authenticated owner of the receiving host can manage cross-host permissions.
授权、Bot 或网络状态已变化，请重新载入后核对。: Permissions, Bots or network membership have changed. Reload and review before continuing.
已允许发送，并从接收主机核对生效。: Sending allowed and verified with the receiving host.
已撤销授权，并从接收主机核对生效。: Permission revoked and verified with the receiving host.
尚未确认保存结果。请重新载入并核对，系统不会自动重复提交授权。: The save result is unconfirmed. Reload and review; permission changes will not be submitted again automatically.
允许其他主机的指定 Bot 向这台主机发送协作消息与文件。: Allow specific Bots on other hosts to send collaboration messages and files to this host.
由接收主机的所有者确认。仅授权所选方向；原任务的结果回复无需反向授权。: The receiving host owner approves this direction only. Replies to the original task do not require reverse permission.
暂无可授权的其他主机。请先在「设备与网络」中将两台主机加入同一网络。: No eligible peer hosts. Add both hosts to the same network in Devices & Network first.
此设备尚未连接来源主机，或来源主机暂时离线。连接后可按名称选择；也可填写准确的: This device is not connected to the source host, or the host is offline. Connect to choose by name, or enter the exact Bot ID.
请核对来源 Bot ID；这里不会自动验证它的名称或创建新 Bot。: Check the source Bot ID carefully. Its name is not verified here, and no new Bot will be created.
包含通过命令行设置的授权。主机离网后授权不会放行，仍可在此撤销记录。: Includes permissions set from the command line. Permissions do not allow access after a host leaves the network; their records can still be revoked here.
保存或放弃修改后，可以切换授权范围。: Save or discard your changes before switching permission scopes.
管理本机与跨主机 Bot 的直接消息权限: Manage direct-message permissions within and across hosts
授权允许列出接收 Bot 的对话名称、发送消息与文件；只可取回自身任务的回复。: Permission allows listing the receiving Bot’s conversation names and sending messages and files. Only replies to the sender’s own tasks can be retrieved.
设备验证已失效，请重新载入后重试。: Device verification is no longer valid. Reload and try again.
内部执行者不参与手动消息授权，请选择普通 Bot。: Internal workers cannot be selected for manual message permissions. Choose a regular Bot.
